topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic establishes the lecture's framing, background concepts, and intended learning outcomes on cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations, selective advantage, and epigenetic alterations drive clonal succession and malignant transformation.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the relationship between tissue stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and the cellular origin of tumors across different cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal support
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external environmental promoters, local inflammation, and stromal interactions provide essential signals that permit tumor development and maintenance.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic outlines the experimental, sequencing, and spatial omics technologies used to study cancer evolution and cell interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of the multifactorial evolutionary model of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic brings together mutational, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary view of cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and outlook
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
